scientific_integrity: The all-dimensional proof uses the standard real Fan–Pall theorem; numerical tests are finite consistency checks and are not substitutes for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed deterministic sampling subspace and independent real Gaussian probes; finite-dimensional PSD matrices.
The optimum is an oracle benchmark dependent on spectrum and trace, not a spectral-free construction.
No guarantee on high-probability loss, computational costs, or unbiased Hutch++ estimators.
Historical-priority assessment has possible unindexed-equivalence risk; no independent audit.
title: Exact spectral water-filling for mean-square-optimal Gaussian trace sampling spaces
